nom: Banila Co Overnight Soothing Cica Sleeping Mask

avis.texte: I applied this mask and left it overnight on my face after cleansing. I washed it off in the morning. I noticed mild irritation and redness on my skin. I won't be using it again.

avis.titre: FABULOUS!! YOU WANT THIS!! I PROMISE!!!
avis.texte: I love to test different skincare products, it’s one of the reasons I love the Amazon Vine program so much because I have that privilege. This is a BIG win!! It feels so great on. It’s soothing and cooling when I put it on. It’s the last step in my nighttime skincare because it feels so good and it just kinda “seals” the previous products I’ve put on. It Makes my skin look nice, feel soft, smooth, moisturized, and plump. It’s easy to apply because it comes with a small applicator to keep the product germ free, which is always a plus. It’s a little pricey at $24.99, but it doesn’t take a lot to cover my face. I highly, highly recommend this.

avis.titre: Cooling, refreshing and hydrating but dries slowly and can make a mess of pillowcases.Cooling, refreshing and hydrating
avis.texte: Cica seems to be the latest trend in skin care and this Korean mask has plenty of it. This wash-off mask is cooling and refreshing but it dries very slowly so it can be a bit messy. The smell is plant-like with some mild floral scents—not bad but not my favorite. The mask is, of course, super hydrating and a great way to refresh my face. Full details of my experience follow. My mask came in a Banilla Co-branded box just under 2 ½ inches tall, and about 3 ¼ in in both width and depth. The green box and tub inside are generously sized, and the packaging is nice, but the doesn’t look or feel premium exactly. On the box are the list of ingredients which I included at the of my review.* Per the Amazon listing, the mask is 76% Centella Asiatica leaf water (Cica) which has calming and healing properties and is loaded with anti-oxidants. My understanding of the formula is that it is supposed to be a hydrating, calming/ soothing, and skin-protecting formulation. I don’t love ethylhexyl palmitate (which could clog pores) in a leave-on skin care product, but overall, the ingredients are satisfactory. The product is a pale green cream from the tub. Once on the skin and thinned out, it becomes an almost clear, watery-looking gel. The smell is very plant-like—I think it is the smell of Cica water with some very mild floral fragrance. The product gives a cooling, hydrating on the skin. My only issue with the product is that once applied, it does take some-time to dry on the skin. On me, it
this mask feels great on skin and is non irritating. light scent that is pleasant, easy to apply. leaves skin calmed and hydrated

This BANILA CO overnight soothing cica sleeping mask is a centella asiatica hydrating mask that is meant to be worn overnight. As a side sleeper who tosses and turns, I decided to try a different method and just apply this and leave it on throughout the day. It definitely is cooling, soothing, hydrating and helps with redness. You could definitely benefit from leaving this on overnight if you don't toss and turn and make a mess... but this is a nice little long duration mask treatment.

avis.titre: Maybe not so great for those with sensitive skin 😔
avis.texte: I really wish I could love this product! It smells amazing and feels as though it would be super hydrating, but unfortunately I seem to be allergic to something in the ingredient list. About an 20 minutes after I applied it my skin became unbearably itchy and when I rinsed it off my whole face was red and swollen 😔 I have used products from this brand on and off for years with no issues but for some reason this specific product really didn't agree with my skin. I have to admit I'm a bit heartbroken over this.

avis.titre: Feels nice and cooling but not itchyFeels nice and cooling but not itchy
avis.texte: I loveee this mask. It feels soo nice on my face and does not leave me itchy or with any burny or weird sensation. It feels cooling but does not tingle. My face feels refreshed and softer once I use this mask. I like using this cica mask after a day out in the sun when I come back flushes and my skin is irritated from the heat and the sun. Feels nice and calming. It also comes with a little plastic spoony thing to help deter bacteria from going in to the mask. After using it, I wipe it down and just put it back in the plastic baggie. I think it is pretty easy to apply.

avis.titre: Hydrating and Lots of Centella Asiatica + Panthenol
avis.texte: I love panthenol, centella asiatica, and adenosine. These are known for their soothing and/or hydrating properties and my skin really enjoys them in my skincare. I appreciate that there's not a lot else going on in the formula because if your skin is irritated or needs calming, the less you're putting on, sometimes the better (less chance of something irritating or making things worse). Which is why I'm surprised this formula has fragrance and it's not even at the end of the ingredients, meaning there’s more fragrance than there is regular water or trehalose! My skin doesn't always mind fragrance (sometimes it does, this time it didn't but my skin is a bit more resilient generally) but if I need something calming, I’d really rather there wasn’t fragrance. I can get panthenol and centella asiatica in other products, it’s the unique combination of having it be so high and meant just to soothe that drew me to this product. With that being said, this feels really nice upon application. It remains somewhat tacky/doesn’t really dry down on the skin which is fine if you use it like a moisturizer but less so if you’re using it like the name suggests, as an overnight mask. In the morning when I washed it off, my skin did feel hydrated and nice though.

avis.titre: works like magic when my skin feels dry or tight
avis.texte: This little tub works like magic for me! It is not a mask in the sense that you have to wash or peel it off--it absorbs so well and so quickly, leaving no greasy or sticky texture or look. I could use this during the day under SPF and makeup. My skin just readily accepted it, if that makes sense. I found that I did not have to use a lot of product to get good coverage, so this larger-size jar will last quite a while--a solid value. I love that there are no serious red-flag ingredients. The fragrance is light and not cloyingly flowery, and seems to fade after a bit of time. It is nothing that would disturb my sleep the way some heavily-fragranced products can.

This is an overnight hydrating moisture machine! It’s not heavy overnight mask (best used in winter months), instead it’s lightweight with a gel like texture that absorbs into the skin beautifully. Non-greasy but moisturizing. My skin is so dry that it drinks this up. This will be my summertime facial mask.

This Overnight Sleeping Mask is a fantastic addition to my skincare routine. It leaves my skin feeling calm, deeply hydrated, and refreshed by morning. The Centella Asiatica and panthenol work wonders for soothing irritation. Perfect for nightly rejuvenation. It has a very nice scent too.

This one is really moisturizing, but, I think I expected a peel off sort of mask, like the ones that dry on your face. This is more one that you rub in, until it absorbs, according to the instructions & then just go to sleep & wake up in the morning and wash your face. When you rub it in, it doesn't feel bad or anything, it actually feels nice & moisturized, maybe slightly tacky, sort of in the same way your face is when it's been moisturized with a really rich moisturizer, if that makes sense? It's not wet or anything though. When you wash in the morning, your skin looks and feels great, so, no complaints here! I would just say, be aware, this isn't a peel mask like you may be thinking, it's more of a heavy moisture that you wash in the morning.

avis.titre: Soothing and moisturizing, but remains tacky
avis.texte: Gel-like texture, very subtle fragrance, feels refreshing on skin and soaks in quickly. Ingredients include Centella Asiatica Leaf Water, Adenosine and Panthenol, as well as Trehalose and several botanical extracts (full list in my photo). And it’s a giant jar, you get 3.38 fl oz. The reason I docked one star, and it’s a pet peeve I have with many sleeping masks, is it remains tacky on skin. I understand that it’s meant for nighttime use, but since I mostly sleep on my side, I don’t like my face sticking to my pillow. Very personal preference though, might not be a big deal to you.
